title: Improving Score Reliability of Multiple Choice Benchmarks with Consistency Evaluation and Altered Answer Choices

bias_targets.methodology: Generating divergent sets of multiple-choice questions by shuffling the order of answer choices and measuring the consistency of the model's responses across these permutations.

Evaluating response consistency by modifying the set of distractors in multiple-choice questions, such as replacing distractors with 'None of the above' or decoupling choices into binary/ternary subsets.
